mentions.title: Legal notice
mentions.introduction: Public information about the site publisher, its use and associated responsibilities.
mentions.reviewNote: This document provides public information about the website and must be reviewed once the firm’s final administrative details are confirmed.

publisher.title: Site publisher
paragraphs: The website archeritage.ma is published by ARCHERITAGE, an architecture practice in Casablanca specialising in land and territorial valorisation, major projects and built heritage valorisation.

contact.title: Public contact details
paragraphs: For any question about the website or a contact request:

hosting.title: Hosting and technical operation
paragraphs: The website is published on managed web hosting infrastructure, in line with the project’s technical configuration (Vercel deployment).
The host’s full contractual details are not reproduced here until they have been confirmed administratively.

intellectual.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The texts, structure, visual identity, project photographs and graphic elements published on this site are protected.
Any reproduction, representation, adaptation or distribution, in whole or in part, requires prior authorisation from ARCHERITAGE, except where permitted by law.

liability.title: Liability
paragraphs: The information presented on this site is general in nature. It does not constitute a study, a diagnosis or a contractual commitment.
Each project is framed according to its context, its project owner and the decisions to be taken.

externalLinks.title: External links
paragraphs: The site may contain links to external resources. ARCHERITAGE has no control over the content of third-party sites and accepts no liability for their content or availability.

privacy.title: Personal data
paragraphs: Processing related to the contact form and the navigation assistant is described in the privacy policy.

legalContact.title: Contact for legal questions
paragraphs: Questions about the website or the use of published content may be sent to ARCHERITAGE’s public contact address.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.introduction: This page factually describes the processing used to respond to requests addressed to ARCHERITAGE through the website.
privacy.reviewNote: This document provides public information about the website and must be reviewed once the firm’s final administrative details are confirmed.

controller.title: Data controller
paragraphs: ARCHERITAGE is the public contact point for requests relating to data submitted through the website.
Contact details are provided at the bottom of this page.

contactForm.title: Data collected through the contact form
paragraphs: The contact form collects only the information you choose to submit, among the following fields:
fields: Optional attachment (PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG or PNG, 5 MB maximum)

attachments.title: Submitted documents
paragraphs: You may optionally attach a document to illustrate your request.
Please submit only what is necessary to understand the project and avoid sensitive or confidential data that is not required.

assistant.title: Navigation assistant
paragraphs: The website provides an assistant for questions about ARCHERITAGE’s public information.
Messages you enter are sent to the site server and then processed by the AI provider configured on the server to generate a response.
The conversation is displayed in your browser for the session; it is not stored in a site database.
Do not use the assistant to submit project documents, highly confidential information or sensitive personal data.

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
paragraphs: Data submitted through the form is used to understand your request, verify its context and prepare a useful first exchange.
Messages sent to the assistant are used solely to produce an orientation response based on the site’s validated public information.
This data is not used for a newsletter, advertising or commercial profiling.

recipients.title: Recipients and technical providers
paragraphs: Validated contact requests are forwarded by email to the operational address configured by ARCHERITAGE.
Assistant messages are processed by the AI provider configured on the server (for example GitHub Models or OpenAI, depending on the active configuration).
Site hosting relies on managed infrastructure (Vercel deployment).

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: The site may store your language preference in a locale cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) to maintain your chosen language while browsing.
No advertising, non-essential analytics or retargeting cookies are currently declared on the site.
The assistant does not persist conversation history in the browser’s local storage beyond the current session.
No consent banner is displayed while no non-essential trackers are active.

security.title: Security
paragraphs: The contact form is subject to server-side checks: hidden anti-spam field, request-rate limiting, format validation and attachment size controls.
No transmission over the Internet offers absolute security; ARCHERITAGE applies reasonable measures given the nature of requests received.

rights.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access to, rectification or deletion of information you submitted through the site, within the applicable legal framework.
Requests relating to personal data may be sent to contact@archeritage.ma.
Any request may be subject to identity verification when necessary.

updates.title: Updates
paragraphs: This policy may be updated to reflect changes to the site or its processing. The last updated date appears at the bottom of the page.
